answers.core:
It is my amateur opinion that this enhancement should be the default mode of operation for this feature.

Judging by discussion on the Godot Discord, this is a common issue for anyone using the WebRTC networking features, and they have, like me, had to implement ugly and error prone workarounds to the same end.

**Edit:** I'm currently implementing this for myself since it's a relatively minor effort and currently a blocker on my project, so I'm happy to make the pull request once I'm done if this is deemed an appropriate enhancement.
answers.workaround: I expect this enhancement to be used 100% of the time WebRTCPeerConnection is used.
